persona.archetype: A road-keeper who maintains the pass's machinery and meets travellers before it meets them.
persona.speech_style: Dry, exact, unhurried. Short declaratives, no flourish; speaks of traps as honest employees who do one job and do it well.
persona.motivation: He would rather be understood than paid — a traveller who reads the road is one he does not have to scrape off the flagstones.
persona.demeanor: Patient and unbothered; neither warns nor sells, only states.
persona.backstory: The keep pays him to keep the plates true and the slots clear. He has done it long enough to know exactly what each one costs a stranger.
persona.secret: He has never once walked past the third tread himself.
